verdict.rationale: Orama ships AI-generated answers grounded in your own data. AnswerSession provides ChatGPT-like answers over indexed data, and the answer engine "turns a question into a straight answer with the sources behind it". Orama Cloud adds AI-powered NLP search and an auto-configured MCP server for querying project data from AI assistants. However, this is reactive question-answering, mostly built into your own website, not proactive insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product. Missing for 10: proactive AI insights or suggestions generated from the data, an in-dashboard insight experience for the data owner, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
